implementation: Implemented immutable L4 book snapshots and consecutive timestamped depth/trade events, price-priority aggressive depth walking, price-time resting queue replay, canonical deterministic Fill production, partial-order lifecycle updates, explicit fidelity/model identity, depth-walk market impact, and content-addressed replay results.
queue_model_assumptions: A simulated resting order joins behind displayed quantity at its limit price.
New displayed quantity joins behind the simulated order.
Depth reductions remove queue-behind before queue-ahead; trade events consume queue-ahead, the simulated order, queue-behind, then unmatched quantity.
The model is L4 research/simulation evidence and does not claim actual exchange queue priority.

tests.v5_regression: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run pytest tests/contract/test_v5_001_tick_replay.py tests/contract/test_v5_002_order_book.py tests/contract/test_v5_003_paper_adapter.py tests/contract/test_v5_004_algorithms.py tests/contract/test_v5_005_exposure.py tests/contract/test_v5_006_calibration.py -q
tests.full_gate_result: lock, format, ruff, mypy, secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 11 property, 859 contract, and health passed

acceptance_mapping.queue_conservation: Every QueueTransition enforces trade = ahead-consumed + own-fill + behind-consumed + unmatched and ahead-before = ahead-consumed + ahead-after; randomized property tests cover queue sizes and trade volumes.
acceptance_mapping.depth_conservation: Every DepthConsumption enforces before = consumed + after; randomized property tests prove total aggressive fills never exceed eligible displayed depth.
acceptance_mapping.partial_fill_truth: tests/fixtures/v5_002_order_book_truth.json freezes a synthetic golden snapshot/event stream with expected queue-ahead path, two partial fills, and remaining quantity.
acceptance_mapping.market_impact: Aggressive replay records best-price-to-VWAP adverse impact and basis points while preserving per-level consumption.
acceptance_mapping.determinism_and_anomalies: Same sample/order/config yields identical replay digest and Fill IDs; sequence gaps/order and clock regression fail closed.

limitations: The checked-in truth sample is a synthetic golden oracle for deterministic semantics, not a claim of exchange-specific queue calibration.
Exchange-specific calibration and paper-vs-replay error intervals remain V5-006.
Research and simulation only; no real order routing.
model_output_not_authoritative: Roadmap Acceptance is decided by deterministic contracts, property tests, the frozen truth oracle, and the full repository gate.
